rawContent: Though the word 'disappointment' doesn't begin to describe my emotions at this time, I WILL NOT GIVE UP in advocating for change as well as for all clergy sexual abuse victims to be heard, acknowledged and to recieve some sort of justice. #ChurchToo #SBCtoo #MeToo

If the church is not willing to hold the pastor accountable, such as in my case, then the church should be disaffiliated from the broader organization. There has got to be accountability somewhere! #ChurchToo #SBCtoo #MeToo
...When the money keeps coming in, the need for power and control grows. When the need for power and control grows, survivors are ignored. #ChurchToo #SBCtoo #MeToo

"THE CLARITY MAKES THE REFUSAL [TO ACT] FEEL ESPECIALLY CRUEL."
@jenlyell The same is true for me...and I too, hate that you and many other survivors know this reality as well. It is tragic we are left to bond over such blatant dismissal. #ChurchToo #SBCtoo #MeToo
